_about: Ships at sea (sea step 5a). Director: ship-local decks (players walk the rolling deck), a WORLD FLEET (ships belong to the host's world and stay where left), Valheim wind with sail settings, the HELMSMAN'S Sailing level gates the ship tier and his perks apply. stages: what W / S step through at the helm (sail 0..1 of the wind's push, oars m/s without wind, negative = backwards). wind_efficiency: [degrees off the wind, share of the push]; 0 = the wind straight from behind, 180 = straight into it (no way forward on sail). wind_floor: the push at no wind (0) .. full at wind 1. Per ship (all sizes metres, ship space: x starboard, y up from the waterline, -z the bow): outline = half-widths of the deck along z (stern first), deck = deck height, draft = keel below the waterline, bulwark = rail height above the deck, top_speed m/s at full sail in the best wind, accel m/s per second, turn_deg per second at full way (turn_slow share at rest), sailing_level = the helmsman's Sailing level needed, xp_per_100m = Sailing xp for the helmsman per 100 m under sail, helm / anchor / mast = spots on deck, tilt = how far waves and wind may lean her. fleet: ships placed in the sea at the start (sea coordinates x, z, yaw degrees with 0 = bow to the north). ALL NUMBERS ARE MY PLACEHOLDERS.
